description: Na₃LiGa₄(SiO₃)₈ is Esseneite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.87 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.89 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.88 Å. Li is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.51 Å. There are four inequivalent Ga sites. In the first Ga site, Ga is bonded to six O atoms to form GaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent GaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ga-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.14 Å. In the second Ga site, Ga is bonded to six O atoms to form GaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent GaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ga-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.10 Å. In the third Ga site, Ga is bonded to six O atoms to form GaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent GaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ga-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.12 Å. In the fourth Ga site, Ga is bonded to six O atoms to form GaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent GaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ga-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.11 Å. There are four inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three GaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-59°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.66 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three GaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-61°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.66 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three GaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-59°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.66 Å. In the fourth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three GaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-60°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.66 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Ga, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Ga, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Li, one Ga, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Ga, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Ga, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaGa₂Si tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to one Li, two Ga, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OLiGa₂Si tetrahedra. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ga, and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Ga, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaGa₂Si tetrahedra. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, and two Si atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Si atoms. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Si atoms.
